LanguageData.CC_Herd_Leader_Pens: The colony's herd goes where {PET_nameDef} goes. The old {KIND} has led them about the pens for a while without anyone saying so; today {PAWN_nameDef} said so, and gave {PET_objective} the name.\n\nThe herd will follow {PET_nameDef} until {PET_pronoun} is too old to lead it, and then one of {PET_possessive} own, if there is one.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_LastSeason_Bird: {PET_nameDef}, who leads the colony's herd, is old now: ragged in the feather, slow off the roost, the herd keeping to {PET_possessive} pace. {PAWN_nameDef} thinks this is the old leader's last season, and means to make it a good one.\n\nWhen {PET_nameDef} goes, the herd will follow one of {PET_possessive} own, if there is one.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_LastSeason_Other: {PET_nameDef}, who leads the colony's herd, is old now: slow in everything, the herd keeping to {PET_possessive} pace. {PAWN_nameDef} thinks this is the old leader's last season, and means to make it a good one.\n\nWhen {PET_nameDef} goes, the herd will follow one of {PET_possessive} own, if there is one.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringBorn: {PET_nameDef}, born today to {OTHER_nameDef}, is the first of the year born to the colony's herd. {PAWN_nameDef} is going down to the pens to look, and will stay a while.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringHatched: {PET_nameDef}, hatched today from one of {OTHER_nameDef}'s eggs, is the first of the year born to the colony's herd. {PAWN_nameDef} is going down to the pens to look, and will stay a while.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringChronicle_Young: The first {YOUNG} of spring, {PET_nameDef}, was born to the herd.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringChronicle_YoungHatched: The first {YOUNG} of spring, {PET_nameDef}, hatched in the herd.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringChronicle_Born: {PET_nameDef} was the first born to the herd this spring.
LanguageData.CC_Herd_SpringChronicle_BornHatched: {PET_nameDef} was the first hatched in the herd this spring.
